relations.name: R-U-R
relations.description: Reviews posted by the same user
relations.notes: High feature similarity (0.991) but moderate label similarity (0.909). Fraudsters sharing user accounts create camouflage through feature mimicry.

relations.name: R-T-R
relations.description: Reviews sharing the same product rating (stars)
relations.notes: Moderate relation — star ratings are easy to manipulate but provide weak structural signal for fraud detection.

relations.name: R-S-R
relations.description: Reviews with the same text sentiment polarity score
relations.notes: Sentiment is harder to fake consistently. Provides moderate signal for detecting coordinated fraud campaigns.
